title: Drift-tolerant trusted-main push fallback for completed Hostinger build-log evidence

phases.objective: Harden the trusted-main ARM marker fallback so delayed runner allocation cannot invalidate an otherwise authorized GET-only evidence push merely because unrelated main commits landed afterward.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository owner, GitHub Actions, and the configured Hostinger read credential
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A squash merge to main changes only the exact R3C marker and uses the fixed V2 trigger token as the first commit-message line.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The delayed ARM job checks out the immutable push SHA, proves it remains an ancestor of live main, proves the canonical workflow/reporter/test blobs are unchanged at both the event SHA and live main, and only then records the claim and performs the one GET-only completed-build log read.
steps: Check out the exact github.sha with complete history rather than the moving main ref.
Validate the event is a main push and the checkout equals the immutable event SHA.
Read live main and prove the event SHA is still contained in its ancestry.
Validate the event changed only the exact R3C marker, with the required first-line token and marker body.
Validate the canonical workflow, reporter, and reporter-test blob identities at both the event SHA and live main.
Validate Incident #4953 remains open and no R3C claim or completed marker exists.
Record one durable R3C claim after all immutable and live-head checks pass.
Run the canonical reporter regression without credential access.
Perform one authenticated GET for completed build 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658 logs.
Scrub the configured provider token from persisted evidence, upload the artifact, and publish the bounded result.
Require expected Production SHA provenance before the workflow succeeds.
assertions: The workflow has contents read and issues write only.
No workflow_dispatch, issue_comment, pull_request, or pull_request_target execution surface exists.
The checkout is pinned to github.sha and uses full history.
The immutable event SHA must be an ancestor of live main; exact equality is not required.
The target workflow, reporter, and reporter-test blobs must match the reviewed values at both event SHA and live main before the claim.
Only the canonical reporter reads secrets.HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN.
The Hostinger provider method is GET only.
No build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, provider mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, protected-ref mutation, force update, or external business send occurs.
The exact provider token is removed from persisted evidence before artifact upload.
The result comment records event main SHA, live main SHA, and event_is_live_main_ancestor=true.
The R3C binding cannot be reused after claiming or completion.

phases.objective: Merge the inert V2 registration and then merge one exact R3C marker to obtain completed-build source-provenance evidence even if unrelated main commits land before runner allocation.
Fail closed on non-ancestor event history, marker, token, blob, Production, issue, or binding drift while tolerating unrelated descendant movement of main.
This workflow is GET-only evidence and performs no Hostinger mutation canary.
This workflow does not deploy, activate, restart, or mutate Production.
